component.name: Arelm
component.summary: A relm4 counter, packaged for Android via pixiewood

description.p: Arelm is a minimal proof-of-concept application demonstrating relm4 (a reactive, Elm-inspired application framework for GTK4/Rust) built and packaged for Android using gtk-android-builder (pixiewood).
The same relm4 component runs unmodified on the desktop (via `cargo run`) and on Android (built as a cdylib and loaded by GTK's Android backend).
